plan: Given my value of $36, I want to bid less than my value to ensure a profit if I win. Assume others bid around their values, possibly slightly lower to secure profit. To maximize profit, I'll bid slightly below my value, anticipating others won't exceed theirs by much. A bid of $32 maximizes potential profit while still being competitive.

Given my value of $8, bidding higher than this would result in a loss if I win. I expect others to bid close to their values, possibly slightly lower to ensure profit. Bidding exactly $8 may lead to a win if others undervalue or bid conservatively. If I bid lower, I risk losing even if others bid near their values. Therefore, I will bid $8 to maximize potential profit without incurring a loss.
